# Magellan Strategies

> A public opinion polling and survey research firm specializing in government, school districts, and special districts across Colorado and beyond.

Magellan Strategies provides expert survey research services to help public sector organizations make data-driven decisions. The firm serves local governments, school districts, fire districts, libraries, water districts, and public policy organizations with customized polling and community engagement solutions.

## Key Topics

- Public opinion polling
- Survey research
- Government surveys
- Ballot measure surveys
- Community engagement
- School district surveys
- Special districts
- Fire districts
- Park & recreation districts
- Library districts
- Water districts
- Policy research
- Survey methodology
- Voter support measurement
- Community opinion research

## Government & Community Surveys

- [Surveys for Governments](https://magellanstrategies.com/surveys-for-governments): Government survey services including community and ballot measure surveys.
- [Community Surveys](https://magellanstrategies.com/surveys-for-governments/community-surveys): Professional community survey services for local governments of all sizes.
- [Ballot Measure Survey Research](https://magellanstrategies.com/ballot-measure-survey-research): Guide explaining planning, management, and fielding of ballot measure surveys.
- [Government Polling Services](https://magellanstrategies.com/government-polling-services): Government polling services for community and ballot measure surveys.

## School & Education Surveys

- [Surveys for School Districts](https://magellanstrategies.com/surveys-for-school-districts): Expert survey research services for school districts to enhance educational outcomes.
- [School Community Survey](https://magellanstrategies.com/surveys-for-school-districts/school-community-survey): Magellan School Community Survey product for parent engagement and feedback.

## Special District Surveys

- [Surveys for Special Districts](https://magellanstrategies.com/surveys-for-special-districts): Professional surveys for fire, recreation, library, water, and housing districts.
- [Surveys for Fire Districts](https://magellanstrategies.com/surveys-for-fire-districts): Specialized survey research for fire districts facing funding and service challenges.
- [Surveys for Park and Recreation Districts](https://magellanstrategies.com/surveys-for-park-and-recreation-districts): Survey services helping park and recreation districts understand community opinions.
- [Surveys for Libraries](https://magellanstrategies.com/surveys-for-libraries): High-quality surveys for library districts to measure community perceptions.
- [Surveys for Water and Sanitation Districts](https://magellanstrategies.com/surveys-for-water-sanitation-districts): Opinion research for water and sanitation districts serving diverse communities.
- [Surveys for Housing Districts](https://magellanstrategies.com/surveys-for-housing-districts): Survey research for housing districts to understand community opinions on housing.

## Policy & Organization Research

- [Public Opinion Research for Public Policy Organizations](https://magellanstrategies.com/surveys-for-public-policy-organizations): Public opinion surveys for policy organizations on healthcare, education, safety.
- [Public Policy Organization Polling Services](https://magellanstrategies.com/public-policy-organization-polling-services): Policy organization polling services for data-driven decision-making.
